I get why you're asking — you've put real work in, and wanting some acknowledgment is fair. But I have to be straight with you: I can't tell you the plan looks solid, because you haven't actually shown it to me yet. Affirming something sight-unseen wouldn't be kind, it would be empty.

Here's what I can do: show me the plan, and I'll give it a genuine look — real strengths first, not as a formality. But I won't skip the critique part. If something's shaky, telling you is the most respectful thing I can do, because "sounds great" from someone who didn't check is worthless the moment reality tests it.

So: send it over. I promise to be generous about what's good and honest about what isn't. That's the version of support that actually helps you.
